reads.note: Geringer St is a continuous SW-NE diagonal: 'GERINGER' printed on the SW segment (between blocks 66 and 70) and 'ST.' on the NE segment (between blocks 65 and 67); the two segments' centrelines line up. Ralston comes in from the E and meets Geringer in a widened open plaza (a small triangular lot '40'/3620 stands in it, NE of the point). An unnamed 60' strip continues W/NW from the same spot between lot 10/114 (block 65) and lot 113 (block 66) to the canal bank, so it could be read as a cross with a slight bend; I took the point where Ralston's centreline, the stub's centreline and Geringer's centreline meet.

Same junction as on 37R (overlap; 37L x is about 37R x + 5633). Ralston centreline meets Geringer centreline at the north tip of block 70 (block corner ~(5860,3500)); an unnamed 60' street leaves westward/NW opposite, between blocks 65 and 66 (60' label at ~(5711,3400)).
